Name: FS Wide legs (shoes and pants)
Author: Nastasis
Description:
This mod was started by me to cover my need for short summer shoes. Then I got carried away, as one does. 😅

My problem was that I've always played with an amazing mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] by not less amazing [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url], and I got so used to having their sprite of the farmer with wider legs that I didn't even realize that it's not in the base game! (Well, apart from the farmer in a swimsuit for some reason.) And I wanted some summer shoes. 

So, inspired by other talented creators I've tried to give it a go and made my collection. It contains 8 shoes with wide legs and 4 pairs of slightly tweaked farmer's pants. 

Shoes sprites are based on a complete female farmer sprite from the game files [b]as well as[/b] from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url] mod. So it can seamlessly blend with your game whether you have [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me?gameId=1303]Poltergeister's[/url] mod or not. (Why not though, check it out, it's so good!) Some frames are heavily based on the [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me?gameId=1303]Poltergeister's[/url] sprite, others are completely redesigned by me.

List of shoes:

[list]
[*]Simple flats - based on standard female farmer's boots from the game
[*]Round nose flats (3 types)
[*]Square toed flats
[*]Simple short boots - standard farmer's boots from the game, redesigned for wide legs
[*]Square nose short boots - designed by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url],  I took them from their sprite and adapted them for Fashion Sense. Some middle frames vary from the original sprite, it's not a complete copy, so please be aware.
[*]Square nose high boots - designed by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url], same as short ones.
[/list]
Then I got an issue with standard farmer's pants. Their initial design works only for boots, so I needed to lengthen them a bit. I also adore mods made by incredible [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/wabiii/mods?gameId=1303]wabiii[/url], in particular [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13545]FS The Coquette Collection[/url]. So I needed my pants to match their colorway. 

So the list of pants consists of two longer farmer pants in two colorways, standard and light, and two extra long pants in the same colorways. All based on the standard farmer pants from the original game files. Check out the screenshots: light pants are meant for [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/wabiii/mods?gameId=1303]wabiii's[/url] mod, and darker ones have the same palette as the standard game ones.

I appreciate the feedback. If you find any bugs or frames you think are in need to be improved, please let me know.

[color=#00ff00]UPDATE: [/color]Now each of the flat shoes comes with [b]colorable[/b] socks option: short and longer version. Use layer option in the main FS window to choose the color for the shoes and for the socks. Check out the screenshots!

Enjoy!

For screenshots I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13545]FS The Coquette Collection[/url] mod by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/wabiii/mods?gameId=1303]wabiii[/url].
